# Arda Karaduman

> arda.tr is the personal catalogue of Arda Karaduman — a software developer between Istanbul and Tokyo. Resume, blog, AI chat, and a showcase of products, games, tools, and music projects.

## Sections

- [Home](https://arda.tr/): Featured links — resume, blog, AI chat
- About: career background and highlights
- Products, games, and tools: project showcase
- Music: music project links

## Projects

- [Gand](https://gand.tr/): Independent software studio
- [Skriv.ist](https://skriv.ist/): Minimalist ebook reader
- [Fable Spun Kids](https://kids.fable.tr/): Personalized storybooks for children
- [Vigil Today](https://vigil.today/): Smart reminder widget PWA
- [SUDONE](https://sudone.jp/): Sudoku and number puzzles
- [Pagan](https://pagan.tr/): Turkish black metal band — official site
- [Reliquary](https://github.com/c0ze/reliquary): Self-hosted AI memory server (MCP)
